Maak het verschil als Vestigingsmanager

Als Vestigingsmanager ben jij eindverantwoordelijk voor het succes van jouw Lyceo-vestiging. Dankzij jouw inzet krijgen leerlingen de begeleiding die hen helpt effectiever te leren, meer zelfvertrouwen te ontwikkelen en betere resultaten te behalen. Je runt jouw eigen vestiging als een ondernemer binnen de organisatie. Daarnaast ben je actief onderdeel van de dagelijkse praktijk op de vestiging en ondersteun je leerlingen tijdens de huiswerkbegeleiding. Jij krijgt energie van het combineren van onderwijs, management en ondernemerschap. Je bent zelfstandig, besluitvaardig en voelt je verantwoordelijk voor het succes van jouw vestiging. Daarnaast weet je overzicht te bewaren, kansen te signaleren en relaties op te bouwen met leerlingen, ouders, scholen en collega's. Je begrijpt dat kwaliteit, betrokkenheid en resultaat hand in hand gaan. Ervaring in een leidinggevende, coördinerende of ondernemende rol helpt je om snel succesvol te zijn in deze functie.

• hbo werk- en denkniveau;

• affiniteit met het begeleiden en ontwikkelen van jongeren;

We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

London, Barcelona, or UK Remote | £150,900 to £204,100 + stock options & benefits | ✅ Visa sponsorship & relocation available

About our Data Discipline

We have a strong culture of data-driven decision making across the whole company. Data is central to how we understand our customers, shape our products, manage risk and grow Monzo sustainably. We believe in empowering teams with high-quality, trusted data and self-serve analytics, while creating space for Data practitioners to focus on the highest-impact questions, opportunities and decisions.

Our Data Discipline is deeply embedded in Monzo’s product areas. Data Scientists, Analytics Engineers, and Machine Learning Engineers work in cross-functional squads alongside Engineers, Designers, Product Managers and other disciplines. This means Data is not a downstream service, and instead we shape strategy, challenge thinking, build the data foundations teams need to move quickly, and share accountability for customer and commercial outcomes.

Our EU team ⭐

Our EU Data team is a full-stack Data team, and together we're building Monzo's presence across Europe from the ground up. We're entering new markets, learning what customers in each one need and finding product-market fit for Monzo.

Our mission is to make money work for everyone, everywhere. As Data Director for EU expansion you'll lead the Data team and shape our product strategy as we grow, deciding where we place our bets, working out what to measure before there's a playbook, and making sure each new market learns fast enough to compound into the next.

You'll work closely with EU leadership (our EU CEO, Country Managers and VP of Product) and Monzo's global Leadership team (the CTO, Head of Data and other Data Directors), sitting on the EU Tech Leadership team and helping shape our global data strategy. To do this well you'll need to relish ambiguity, bringing analytical rigour and commercial judgement to bets that often have to be made before the data is complete.

You’ll play a key role by...

You'll own the full learning loop that EU expansion runs on, and you'll co-own the product development loop alongside EU Leadership, Product and Engineering. In a new market that often means building those loops from scratch, so you're accountable not just for measuring what happens, but for framing the questions, defining what good looks like, and building the systems that answer them. You'll be a senior voice on the EU Tech Leadership team, the person who reframes the hard problems and puts a number on the trade-off between what's valuable for customers and what's valuable for the business.

Shaping product and commercial strategy:

  • You'll decide where Monzo should bet as we enter each new European market, sizing the opportunity and finding product-market fit for the products and segments most likely to win.
  • You'll use sharp commercial judgement to work through the ambiguity of building in a new market, from pricing and positioning to the levers that drive growth, bringing Data into strategy early so we shape priorities rather than react to decisions already made.

Owning the data strategy and the learning loops:

  • You'll set the data strategy for EU and stand up the foundations each new market needs, from the events we log and the metrics and experiments we design to the forecasts markets learn from.
  • Lead the goal-setting process for EU Expansion, bringing clarity to metric selection and target setting, in close partnership with Finance.

Changing how decisions get made:

  • You'll represent Data directly at the ExCo level, building a shared language of metrics and analytical reasoning so that Data drives EU strategy rather than reporting on it.
  • You'll drive cross-collective collaboration, spotting the high-leverage connections across the business, for example how savings features drive engagement in our Wealth collective.

Building and leading a high-performing team:

  • You'll build, grow and retain a high-performing, full-stack Data team, where everyone shares accountability for product and business outcomes.
  • You'll raise the performance bar, develop the next generation of Data leaders, and model an inclusive, high-craft Data culture as we scale.

We’d love to hear from you if…

What we're doing here at Monzo excites you, and the idea of helping take it across Europe especially so!

  • You're a strategic data leader who has operated at Director level or above, and you're energised by zero-to-one ambiguity, having built or scaled a data function in a new market, product line or business from an early stage.
  • You move comfortably from detailed metrics and data architecture to customer strategy, commercial outcomes and product-market fit, and you're happy to be the opinionated voice in the room that reframes the trade-off.
  • You lead through learning loops and hold a high technical bar, because you've built or owned the measurement a business relies on to set goals, run experiments and improve, with the judgement to know which methods and investments will pay off.
  • You have experience leading company-wide or division-wide goal-setting, defining high-clarity metrics, setting targets and partnering closely with Finance.
  • You change how organisations make decisions, not just how one project turns out, and you have experience of the cross-collective collaboration that connects the dots across different business areas.
  • You're an empathetic people leader who has grown full-stack Data teams of both individual contributors and managers, comfortable representing Data at ExCo and to C-level peers, and you know what it takes to attract, develop and retain top talent.

You'll build the interfaces people use to run H's agents: the H Platform, where teams deploy an agent, follow it live and replay what it did step by step, and HoloTab, our Chrome extension that controls the browser on its user's behalf. The work is mostly front end, in React and TypeScript, with changes to the Python APIs behind it when a feature calls for them.

H builds agents that use a computer the way a person does, in the browser and on the desktop.

What you'll own

How people watch, steer and replay an agent while it acts on a computer, which has few established patterns yet. You'll decide how a live run appears and plays back, how live data gets to the screen, how a feature splits between front end and API, and which components become shared standards. We'll judge the work by what ships to users, by front-end quality held in CI, and by whether people can follow and control what an agent did.

What you'll be doing

  • Building the H Platform web app
  • Building and improving the HoloTab extension
  • Designing the live run view and replay
  • Changing the Python APIs behind a feature
  • Setting shared component patterns
  • Making long-running workflows easier for FDEs and customers to deploy and watch

The first year

Within three months, a feature you built, API change included, is with users. Within six, one surface is yours, such as live runs and replay or the HoloTab interface, and the team comes to you about it. Within a year, you're working across several of our products, agreeing what to build with their owners and then building it.

Your team and your users

The role sits in Product Engineering, with our VP of Engineering as hiring manager. You'll work closely with the owners of the H Platform and HoloTab. Your users are our Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs), our technical customers and the people who use HoloTab every day.

What we think it takes

You're likely a good fit if you:

  • Have shipped a production product in React and TypeScript as a senior engineer
  • Make the API change a feature needs as well as the UI
  • Write correct, concurrent code
  • Handle live, async data in the UI correctly
  • Enjoy working out what users actually need and designing the interface around it
  • Have worked with Python

Stronger still if you have worked with:

  • Chrome extensions or the Chrome DevTools Protocol
  • Real-time interfaces using streaming, SSE or WebSockets
  • Design systems or component libraries
  • FastAPI or a similar Python API framework
  • Preact and Vite

You do not need a background in Python backend development. If you match most of this but not every point, apply anyway.

How we hire

Four stages: a 30-minute call with our Talent team, a 60-minute coding interview, a take-home front-end exercise of about 2 hours with a 45-minute review, and a closing 30-minute conversation. The take-home is built around the kind of interface you'll be working on.

Practicalities

The role is hybrid, with three days a week in our Paris or London office and a visit to the other office every four to six weeks or so. We offer a competitive package.

Our team shared's mission is deploy AI agents to transform how patients and doctors connect

We believe healthcare shouldn't be defined by missed calls, endless waiting lines, and overwhelmed staff. Patients and professionals deserve better.

Vocca builds AI voice agents that answer every call instantly, schedule and reschedule appointments, and free up staff to focus on what matters most: care.

Already trusted by 3500+ providers, we're transforming the patient-provider relationship, one call at a time.

Want to shape the future of healthcare?

Join us !

- Discover our company culture and values

- Here is a product Demo

- Meet the team

- Article on our seed round of 5,5M$

The problem you will solve

Every medical practice runs on software that holds its calendar and its patients. There are dozens of different ones. Most were built twenty years ago and some have no API at all. To book an appointment during a call, our AI agent has to read and write in that software in real time, while the patient waits on the line. Nobody else has managed to build this. On several of these systems, Vocca is the only integrator in the world.

This is also the team with the most direct impact on the business. A clinic whose software is connected to our agent does not switch. Retention, pricing power, our lead over competitors: it all depends on these integrations.

The next step is writing back. Today the agent reads and books. Tomorrow it updates records in EHR, PMS and RIS systems, which raises the reliability bar a lot. In the US, we are opening the dental software ecosystem, with the compliance work that comes with it (HIPAA, SOC2).

The long term vision is simple: the agent becomes the action layer between patients and everything the front desk used to do by hand. The integrations are the road to get there. You would be building that road.

What you will own

- The architecture of our booking layer. Today it is code written provider by provider, under pressure. It is becoming one unified layer in TypeScript that can handle the rules of each medical centre and where adding a new software takes days, not weeks.

- Speed and reliability at more than 1 million calls a month. A call to a clinic software can take several seconds, and the patient cannot wait. You will decide how we detect a booking failure in a clinic within 24 hours and what a healthy integration looks like.

- The hard integrations that nobody else wants to do. They are what makes Vocca hard to replace.

- How the team works. Engineering team is growing fast and will organise in squads. You will define how this one works: reviews, documentation, technical decisions. You will be one of the most experienced engineers in the company and we will expect you to act like it.

Stack

TypeScript everywhere (Node, monorepo), PostgreSQL, REST and SOAP APIs from software vendors.
